messages:
incident-bot: Pager: Billing metering anomaly detected in prod (token_count_delta > threshold) — page sent to #incidents and on-call. See /incidents/2371234567 for context
Alice (oncall): Got the page, I'm looking. Initial alert says token_count_delta spike for region-eu across the aggregator service.
Alice (oncall): Quick status: able to reproduce the high delta in the streaming ingest window. Metrics: tokens_emitted upstream normal, tokens_counted_by_billing higher by ~18% for last 3h.
Jamie SRE: pinging — any obvious deploys in last 6h?
Neil (eng-ops): No deploys to ingest or billing pipeline in last 8h. Autoscaler events only.
Maria (billing): We're seeing a surge of overage flags triggering automated emails to a subset of customers (approx 120 accounts). Can we get an ETA on mitigation? Customers are already opening tickets.
Olivia (support): Escalations inbound. I have a list of 12 customers who reported unexpected overage notices. Adding a thread to Customer Ops.
Alice (oncall): First triage: either double-counting at the aggregator -> batch windowing; or late replays in the ingest (duplicate records). I'll check dedupe logic and recent Kafka consumer offsets.
Jamie SRE: Helpful logs:
```
2026-03-15T09:12:23Z aggregator: processed batch id=abc123 size=1024 tokens=204800
2026-03-15T09:12:23Z billing-ingest: emitted tokens=204800 metadata={window_start:09:12}
2026-03-15T09:12:24Z aggregator: reprocess batch id=abc123 reason=consumer-rebalance
```
Jamie SRE: That reprocess line looks suspicious — reprocessing same batch can cause duplicate emits if dedupe not applied before counting.
Neil (eng-ops): Consumer rebalance occurred after a transient ZK timeout, reassigning partitions. Some commits may have been lost leading to reprocessing.
Maria (billing): If duplicates passed downstream into the usage-counter, that would immediately inflate counts and trigger overage rules. We need to know which customer partitions were affected.
Alice (oncall): Running a quick query to compare unique request IDs in billing window vs emitted tokens.
Alice (oncall): Query snippet: `SELECT count(*) as total, count(distinct request_id) as unique_requests FROM usage_events WHERE ts BETWEEN ...`
Alice (oncall): Results: total=1,220,340 tokens events, unique_requests correspond to 1,036,987 -> discrepancy aligns with ~17.7% duplicates.
Jamie SRE: Confirmed, duplicate request_ids correlate to consumer-rebalance time. Root cause likely consumer offset handling + reprocess path emitting without marking dedupe flag.
Neil (eng-ops): Short-term mitigation options: 1) Pause automated overage email pipeline, 2) Backfill dedupe and recompute billing counts, 3) Roll forward a quick patch to mark reprocessed batches with a dedupe token.
Maria (billing): We can't silently change customer bills without approval. But we should stop new overage alerts until counts are reconciled. Please pause the alerting/notification topic now if possible.
Alice (oncall): I'm pausing the overage-notifications SNS topic (manual fail-safe) — doing now.
incident-bot: action: overage-notifications SNS paused by Alice at 2026-03-15T09:26:12Z
Alice (oncall): Paused. Next: protect the live pipeline. I'll put consumers into read-only mode for the billing path and enable dedupe fast-path.
Jamie SRE: I'll open a canary dedupe job to scan the last 6 hours and produce corrected deltas (non-destructive). Running on a small window first.
Neil (eng-ops): I'll check for any recent infra change to the consumer group config that might skip commits. Also rolling broker logs for partition leaders.
Olivia (support): Notifying the 12 customers who reported emails with: "We've paused automated overage emails while we investigate a metering anomaly. No charges will be finalized until counts are reconciled." Want legal/billing to sign off?
Maria (billing): Yes please route the message through billing ops. I'll push an approved template now.
Maria (billing): Template: "We observed an internal metering issue that may have caused incorrect overage notifications. We have paused notifications and are working to reconcile metrics. No invoices will be sent based on the affected data window. We'll follow up with a root cause and remediation timeline."
Alice (oncall): Canary dedupe job started. Initial pass found duplicate keys grouped by (customer_id, request_id). Example: customer=acme corp, request_id=R-9823, seen 3x within 2s.
Jamie SRE: Proposed remediation plan (short): 1) Pause notifications (done), 2) Run dedupe pass and compute corrected deltas, 3) Re-enable notifications with reconciled counts and customer-facing note, 4) Release a robust fix to ensure reprocessed batches are idempotent.
Neil (eng-ops): For the durable fix I'll add a commit-on-ack pattern to ensure consumer offsets are recorded before reprocessing begins. Low-risk patch queued.
Alice (oncall): We're seeing the corrected deltas reducing the variance. Preliminary numbers: duplicate-corrected delta shows only +1.2% residual which is within expected noise.
Maria (billing): Great. What's the timeline for finishing full reconciliation and sending final notices to impacted customers?
Jamie SRE: Full window scan estimated 3h (we're at 30% done), longer if we need deeper cross-checks.
Olivia (support): I'll set customer expectations: "We expect reconciliation completed within ~4 hours, will follow up with final statement."
incident-bot: note: incident severity set to P2 by Alice (oncall).
Alice (oncall): Post-mortem action items (short): 1) Improve consumer rebalance handling and idempotency, 2) Add metric to detect reprocess duplicates earlier, 3) Harden the overage-alert fail-safe with automatic pause on anomaly.
Maria (billing): Also request a manual audit: list of accounts that received overage emails and the amount flagged. I'll coordinate credits/reversals as needed after reconciliation.
Neil (eng-ops): I'll start the patch PR for commit-on-ack, tag @Jamie for review.
Jamie SRE: I'll continue dedupe run and update every 30 minutes. Next update in ~20 min.
Olivia (support): I'll keep the support queue triaged and send hourly updates to affected customers.
Alice (oncall): Thanks everyone. Team we should be careful in communications: don't promise refunds until billing confirms. Keep statements limited to "paused notifications" and timeline.
Alice (oncall): Update 09:46Z: dedupe pass at 55%, corrected deltas now within 2.1% for region-eu. No further automated overage emails were sent after pause.
Jamie SRE: 10:01Z final pass complete, corrected counts computed. Preparing reconciliation package for billing ops (CSV + diff).
Maria (billing): Received package. We'll run our reconciliation, then email customers with final outcome and any credits. Thanks for the quick mitigation.
incident-bot: incident resolved by Alice (oncall) at 2026-03-15T10:10:25Z — severity downgraded to monitor.
Alice (oncall): Closing thread. I'll start a full post-mortem doc and attach logs, timeline, and action owners in #postmortems.
Olivia (support): Posting customer-facing postmortem note draft to #support-channels for review.
Jamie SRE: PR for idempotency fix opened: https://git.redwood/example/pull/482 — tagging for review.
Maria (billing): Follow-ups: billing ops to generate credit plan and confirm customer comms by EOD.
Alice (oncall): Nice work team.
